objective: Auditar si Gobierno_Persona y Gobierno_PersonaVinculo pueden reutilizarse como camino canonico Socio Cava -> Cliente_Catalogo antes de crear cualquier columna, FK, tabla puente o migracion nueva.

queries.name: gate12d_persona_vinculo_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_vinculos, SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_cliente, COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT PersonaID) AS personas_distintas FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo

queries.name: gate12d_socios_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios, SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteCRMID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clientecrmid_null, SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteCRMID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clientecrmid_present FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios

queries.name: gate12d_cava_link_columns
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS table_name, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) LIKE N'%Cava%' OR OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) LIKE N'%Socio%') AND (c.name LIKE N'%PersonaID%' OR c.name LIKE N'%ClienteID%' OR c.name LIKE N'%VinculoID%') ORDER BY table_name,c.column_id

constraints: Do not create ClienteID, PersonaID, VinculoID or bridge tables
If linkage is not deterministic, return NOT_DETERMINABLE
